 Explore Door County on Foot!
Join us for our comprehensive adventure through Cave Point County Park and White Fish Dunes State Park! This adventure focuses on a naturalist perspective of our shoreline, dunes, and wetlands all in the same hike. You will see the crashing shore of Cave Point, explore the “blow holes” where water jets up like a fountain during heavy waves off Lake Michigan. Discover the history of sand dunes in Wisconsin while walking the perfect sands of the shoreline. Please bring your camera! DSLR, Mirrorless, and phones are all highly encouraged to capture iconic Door County. We provide tenured photography experience to help you catch those waves, dunes and see the sights from the “Old Baldy” lookout. Trails consist of boardwalks, sand, level dirt, along with a few adventurous footsteps in the Cave Point section of the hike. Come experience why we call this the best hike in Door County.
